name: Saint Stephen
history: One of the seven deacons chosen by the apostles to serve the poor, Stephen was stoned to death in Jerusalem for his preaching, praying for his killers as he died. A young man named Saul held the cloaks of those who stoned him.
meditation: Lord, do not hold this sin against them. Forgive someone today.
life: The Acts of the Apostles tells that when the Greek-speaking widows of Jerusalem were neglected in the daily distribution, the apostles chose seven men full of faith and the Holy Spirit to serve them, and Stephen was named first. He also worked wonders and preached with a wisdom his opponents could not answer. Accused falsely of speaking against the Temple and the Law, he was brought before the council, and his face seemed like the face of an angel. He answered with a long account of God's dealings with Israel, then cried out that he saw the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God. He was dragged out and stoned. 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit,' he prayed, and fell asleep. The persecution that followed scattered the Church and carried the Gospel beyond Jerusalem. His relics were found in 415.
prayerTo: Saint Stephen, first martyr, you served the poor and bore witness to Christ, and you died praying for those who stoned you. Pray for deacons and for all who suffer for the faith. Give me a share of your courage and your forgiving heart, that I may love even those who wrong me. Amen.
penance: Give alms today, in the old custom of Saint Stephen's Day, to someone who serves you during the year or to the poor. Pray by name for someone who has hurt you.
prayer: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, to imitate what we celebrate, so that we may learn to love even our enemies; because we keep the anniversary of the invention of Him Who knew how to plead even for His persecutors with our Lord, Jesus Christ, Your Son. Who livest and reignest with God the Father…
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
